hints.content: Therefore, we can set up equivalent proportions and solve for $r$.

$\dfrac{\red{r}}{\blue{12}} = \dfrac{\red{18}}{\blue{13.5}}$

 Note: As each corresponding $\dfrac{\red{\text{side}}}{\blue{\text{side}}}$ proportion is equivalent, you could use the other sides (i.e., $\dfrac{\red{r}}{\blue{12}} = \dfrac{\red{8}}{\blue{6}}$)

Reduce the proportion on the right hand side.

 $\dfrac{\red{r}}{\blue{12}} = \cancel{\dfrac{\red{18}}{\blue{13.5}}}{\green{\dfrac{4}{3}}}$

Multiply each side by $12$ and simplify.

 $\cancel{12} \times \dfrac{\red{r}}{\cancel{\blue{12}}} = \green{\dfrac{4}{3}} \times 12$
